# Console screens and styling `CNS`

[As built](../README.md) › Console screens and styling

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

The full set of screens, navigation, and stylesheets that make up the Fabrika console UI: project onboarding and setup, agent/crew configuration, readings and gate reviews, run history and live progress, guides, and the shared CSS that styles all of them. The rest of the system needs this group to give humans a way to configure, monitor, and approve the factory's work, driven by data.js's routing and render.js's screen dispatch.

47 files, 21,912 lines.
